newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian tourism firms plan to tap bond market.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian tourism firms plan to tap bond market.

text.p: Three privately-owned Tunisian hotel firms simultaneously announced on Wednesday that they were planning to tap the bond market for fresh cash.
Firm El Mouradi said it plans a four-million dinars ($3.8 million) issue at 9.0 percent, guaranteed by Banque du Sud and Banque de l'Habitat.
Societe El Kantaoui Hotel Selima Club said it plans an issue of four million dinars at 9.0 percent garanteed by Banque du Sud and Amen Bank.
Societe Ulysse said it would issue six million dinars at 9.5 percent guaranteed by Amen bank, Arab Tunisian Bank, Banque Nationale Agricole and UIB bank.
None of them released the maturity dates. ($ = 1.048 Tunisian Dinars)
